Your design, cast in GRC and FRP

RJ Interiors & Constructions (RJIC) makes architectural products to order at our facility in Bangalore. Jalis, domes, columns, facade panels, FRP tanks or anything you can draw: we develop the mould, make the piece and deliver it to your site.

Two materials, one factory

Both can take almost any shape. Where the piece goes decides which one suits it best, and we help you choose.

GRCGlass fibre reinforced concrete

Cement and sand reinforced with alkali-resistant glass fibre, cast in thin sections. It has the look of stone but weighs far less than solid concrete.

Made from

  • Cement
  • Sand
  • Water
  • Alkali-resistant glass fibre

Why choose it

  • Stone-like finish
  • Holds fine detail
  • Light for its size

GRC productsHow GRC is made

FRPFibre reinforced plastic

Resin reinforced with glass fibre, built up in a mould. It is light, water-tight and resists corrosion, so it suits tanks and planters as well as mouldings for high places.

Made from

  • Surface coat
  • Glass fibre mat
  • Resin

Why choose it

  • Light to lift and fix
  • Water-tight
  • Resists corrosion

FRP productsHow FRP is made

How GRC and FRP are made

Both start with a mould shaped from your design. Watch what happens next, or choose a stage.

Typical stages. The exact method depends on the piece.

  • Cornices and bracketsGRC

  • Arches, balusters and railingsGRC
  • Arches, gutters and potsFRP

  • FRP facade elementsFRP
  • PlantersFRP
  • Custom FRP productsFRP

All product details

Ordering, start to finish

Here is what happens after you get in touch.

  1. Share the design

    Send drawings, photos, sketches or a sample, with sizes, quantities and the site location.

  2. Agree the details

    We confirm material, dimensions, joints, fixings and finish with you or your architect, then quote.

  3. Develop the mould

    A mould is made for your design, so every piece cast from it matches.

  4. Make and finish

    Pieces are made at our Bangalore facility, then finished and checked against the agreed details.

  5. Deliver and install

    We deliver to your site, and install the pieces on projects where installation is offered.

Who we make for

Bungalows, offices, hotels, institutions, places of worship and industrial sites each need something different from GRC and FRP.

  • Bungalows and villas

    Jali screens, columns, balustrades, cornices and FRP planters for elevations, balconies and gardens.

  • Commercial buildings

    Facade panels, cladding, fins and screens for offices, retail and mixed-use buildings.

  • Hotels and resorts

    Domes, arches, decorative columns and FRP planters for entrances, courtyards and landscapes.

  • Institutions

    Screens, cladding, cornices and FRP tanks for schools, colleges, hospitals and public buildings.

  • Places of worship

    Domes, minarets, arches, jalis and ornament for temples, mosques and churches.

  • Industry

    FRP storage tanks, MS FRP tanks, gutters and cladding for factories and utilities.

One manufacturer behind five brands

You may know us as GRC Bangalore, FRP Bangalore, GRC Chennai, GRC Kochi or GFRC Innovation. RJIC is the parent company of all five, and every product they offer is made at our facility in Bangalore.
